why: Redact third-party personal information from the tracked tree and from history. Privacy hygiene on a public repo; followed by two corrective passes the same day ('a real name missed, a heading wrongly removed') and a switch to box characters instead of [REDACTED] markers.
composition: This map's OLD keys are the 07-23 map's NEW values -- 1,125 of its 1,979 rows. So the chain runs original -> 07-23 -> 08-12 -> today, and a pre-07-23 citation needs BOTH maps applied in order. Measured: the 08-12 map alone recovers 86 of our 877 broken citations; chained with 07-23 it recovers 806. This is the whole argument for keeping every map rather than the latest one.
note: This map was archived off-repo to two drives at the time -- better than the 07-23 one, and still invisible to every clone and to every search plane anyone in this house uses. state/rewrites/ is now the canonical home precisely because it travels.
